_doc: Measured Figma geometry — the ONLY thing that lawfully crosses from design to code.
_law: ui-presentation §8. CROSSES: layout, position, size, spacing, hierarchy, state treatment, colour token NAMES, motion timing. DOES NOT CROSS: art, and every value the sim reads. UI-REFERENCE.md: 'Art: original, always.' Breachpoint ships on Steam; 343/Microsoft art is reference only and lives in Content/Reference/, which is gitignored and in DirectoriesToNeverCook.

_source.role: THE MEASURED SOURCE. Per UI-REFERENCE.md the front end follows this file's LAYOUT SYSTEM. Geometry is matched 1:1; art is drawn fresh.
_source.read_via: Figma MCP get_metadata, live node read

_provenance_warning: SCREEN-MANIFEST.md §4 and COMPONENT-SPECS.md cite these node ids under a heading naming the BREACHPOINT file (yznvnVdOFDADaugZSeomfP) as the target. THE IDS ARE NOT IN THAT FILE. Verified 2 Aug 2026: get_metadata('yznvnVdO...', '1:2') returns 'node ID was not found'; the same id against Kn87U5s... returns the Play frame. Anyone re-measuring must use the file_key above. Filed as a docs correction.

grid._note: The 48px gutter is identical in both layouts, which is what makes them interchangeable. Keep it.

UBRNavBar._resolves: SCREEN-MANIFEST §9 open question #1: x=33 (COMPONENT-SPECS) vs x=44 (SCREEN-BUILD-SPEC). LIVE NODE SAYS 33. Eighteen screens inherit this, so it mattered.

selection_caret._note: Rail-hugging at x=-4. Its authored y encodes the focus index.

reveal_notches._note: 88x4.7 chamfers subtracted from the panel border. The open/close wipe ORIGINATES here — that is why the panel unzips rather than fades.

UBRMenuRow._note: 311 inside the rail's 16px inset; 349 standalone. Gap between rows is 12.

UBRRosterPanel._note: x=862 vs column-3 origin 863 — a 1px authoring drift, not a second grid. Anchor RIGHT: 862+349 = 1211 = 69 from the right edge.

UBRProfileBar._note: Screen invariant. The bottom 50 is always reserved.

UBRButtonPrompt._note: Width tracks prompt count (58/62 for 1, 133/146 for 2, 253 for 3) so it MUST be auto-layout hug, never fixed.

subject._note: The 3D subject box. Column 2 spans 466-815, so the subject sits INSIDE column 2. NO WIDGET may anchor into 466-815 at the 1280 base — that band is the camera (ui-presentation §1).

_not_transferred.art: 815 visible image fills across 14 families, inventoried in ART-PASS-STAGE-2.md as Halo-owned. Stage 4 (produce original art) NOT STARTED; stage 5 (swap into Figma) gated on 4; stage 6 (export to UE) gated on 5. Nothing raster crosses until stage 5 completes per family.
_not_transferred.weapon_glyphs: e.g. node 78:6 'SET Weapon / Magnum' in the Breachpoint file. Weapon icons are RENDERED FROM OUR OWN MESHES per WEAPON-RENDER-PLAN.md and BP25 — never exported from the reference.
_not_transferred.typeface: Rajdhani + Roboto Condensed are OFL and ARE ours to ship. They are the same substitution the reference file itself makes. Not yet imported: Content/UI/Fonts/ is empty.
_not_transferred.strings: 1,561 Halo occurrences, ~130-term mapping table in ART-PASS-STAGE-3.md. Six founder decisions (N1-N6) gate 47% of them.
